property_summary: For any actor and any admissible amount, calling Put(t) with t > block.timestamp must record acc.unlockTime = t (so the deposit stays locked until t); the mutant never updates unlockTime, so c.Acc(actor).unlockTime stays 0 and the invariant fails.
change_summary: Delete the `acc.unlockTime = ...` statement so the unlock time is never updated.
